title: Xanthe and the Protocol Revisited
author: Mara Whitlock
blurb: Cyrus Villalobos, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
